i-am-the-falling-world-msg3zxb4.mp3.title: I Am the Falling World
i-am-the-falling-world-msg3zxb4.mp3.lyrics:
I am the apple tumbling from the bough,
I am the question blazing in the mind,
I am the force that bends all things below,
I am the law that mortals seek to find.

I am the falling world, I am the light,
I am the mathematics burning bright,
Through prism'd glass I break into my parts,
I am the falling world within your hearts.

I am the pendulum, the swinging proof,
I am the motion captured and unnamed,
I am the gravity that pulls you down,
I am the order rising from the flame.

I am the falling world, I am the light,
I am the mathematics burning bright,
Through prism'd glass I break into my parts,
I am the falling world within your hearts.

I am the mirror held up to the sky,
I am the telescope that pierces far,
I am the mystery becoming known,
I am the law inscribed in every star,
I am obsession carved in stone and ink,
I am the space between the stars and brink,
I am the falling, always falling still,
I am the world beholden to my will.

I am the falling world, I am the light,
I am the mathematics burning bright,
Through prism'd glass I break into my parts,
I am the falling world within your hearts.
